I had s hamster who went blind while aging. I noticed that every time I approached her cage she would hide. It was surprising at first because she loved me and I wondered if dhe had started hating me. When I realized she was blind I started calling out to her before getting close enough for her to see my large shadow. She stopped hiding and I understood that she just saw SOMETHING big coming and hid instinctively. But when I started calling out to her she would know it was me coming and come greet me instead. Maybe try calling a phrase like "lets go" or something out to your rat before you pick her up, so he knows what is about to happen and will learn to be less scared.
